October 9, 2026 · Parashat Bereishit · Rosh Chodesh Mar Cheshvan

The Alchemy of the Soul

Transforming the Yetzer Hara and the Bitterness of Mar Cheshvan in Parashat Bereishit

After the Yamim Noraim and Sukkos, ordinary life returns. Drawing on Pri Tzaddik, Resisei Layla, Mei HaShiloach and the Izhbitza–Radzin tradition, this week's essay explores how the yetzer hara, darkness and even the bitterness of Cheshvan can become instruments of spiritual growth.
